parameters.help_en:
The product plan to use.
For more information, see the official documentation: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/product-introduction?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i1
parameters.help_zh:
要接入的产品方案
具体详见官方文档 ：https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/product-introduction?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i1
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The merchant-defined unique business ID for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can contain letters and digits with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The Metainfo environment parameter, which must be obtained from the client SDK
parameters.help_zh: Metainfo环境参数，需要通过客户端SDK获取
parameters.name: meta_info

parameters.help_en:
The document type.
For the eKYC_PRO and ID_OCR_MAX solutions, see the official documentation at https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/certificate-code-table?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-445633.d_2_8_2_0.279147abwKAWbr

For the ID_OCR, eKYC, and eKYC_MIN solutions, see the document type list in the official documentation at https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/gnhekqy05ni51m4c?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-445633.d_2_3_1_0_0_0.6243244777KoZ7
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型
eKYC_PRO和ID_OCR_MAX方案,详见官方文档 https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/certificate-code-table?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-445633.d_2_8_2_0.279147abwKAWbr

ID_OCR,eKYC和eYKC_MIN方案,相见官方文档 证件类型列表 https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/gnhekqy05ni51m4c?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-445633.d_2_3_1_0_0_0.6243244777KoZ7
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en: Your custom user ID, or another identifier that can identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address. We strongly recommend that you desensitize this field value in advance, for example, by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的用户ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如手机号码、邮箱地址等。强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en: The scene code. This is an input parameter for the IDV product
parameters.help_zh: 场景码。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en:
The configuration for capture pages. Separate multiple pages with commas (,). Valid values:
01: the portrait side of the identity document.

01,02: the portrait side and back side of the identity document.

When this parameter is set to 01,02, only China identity cards and Vietnam identity cards are supported
parameters.help_zh:
采集页配置，多页使用,连接。取值范围：
01：证件人像面

01,02：证件人像面与背面

此值传入01,02时，目前仅支持中国身份证和越南身份证
parameters.name: pages

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded face photo. If you use FacePictureBase64 to pass in a face photo, check the photo size and do not pass in an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh: 照片Base64编码。如果您选择FacePictureBase64方式传入人脸照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: face_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face photo. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 人脸照片地址。公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: face_picture_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable cropping. This is an input parameter for the IDV product
parameters.help_zh: 是否裁剪。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable OCR. This is an input parameter for the IDV product
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启OCR。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: ocr

parameters.help_en: The face image quality. This is an input parameter for the IDV product
parameters.help_zh: 人脸图片质量。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: id_face_quality

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable document anti-forgery detection. This is an input parameter for the IDV product
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用证书防伪检测。（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: id_spoof

parameters.help_en: The client-side callback URL
parameters.help_zh: 端侧回调地址
parameters.name: return_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authoritative identity verification. Currently, this parameter applies only to second-generation ID cards in the Chinese mainland. This is an input parameter for the IDV product
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启身份权威核验，目前仅适用于中国大陆二代身份证（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: authorize

parameters.help_en: The document capture and photo mode
parameters.help_zh:
证件采集拍照模式。

manual：手动拍照。
auto：自动拍照（默认）
parameters.name: doc_scan_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the order of document and face verification steps. Valid values:

DOC_FACE: Document first, then face. This is the default value.
FACE_DOC: Face first, then document.

Note: This parameter is required only when ProductCode is set to KYC_GLOBAL
parameters.help_zh:
支持卡证和人脸顺序编排：

DOC_FACE（默认）
FACE_DOC

注：只有当ProductCode为KYC_GLOBAL需传
parameters.name: product_flow

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for the authentication result. The callback request method is GET by default, and the callback URL must start with https. After the authentication is complete, the platform calls back this URL and automatically adds the transactionId, passed, and subcode fields
parameters.help_zh: 认证结果的回调通知地址，回调请求方式默认为GET，回调地址必须以https开头。平台在完成认证后会回调该地址，并自动添加transactionId、passed和subcode字段
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en: The security token used for anti-replay and anti-tampering verification. If this parameter is specified, the CallbackToken field is displayed in the callback URL
parameters.help_zh: 安全Token，用于防重复、防篡改校验。如果传入该参数会在回调地址显示CallbackToken字段
parameters.name: callback_token

parameters.help_en: The language configuration. This is an input parameter for the IDV product
parameters.help_zh: 语言配置（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: language_config

parameters.help_en: The mode that represents different security levels of the authentication process. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
代表认证流程不同安全水位的模式，可选值：

01：普通模式（默认）。
02：安全模式，相对严格的模式，可用于高风险场景（IDV产品入参）
parameters.name: security_level

parameters.help_en: The custom UI configuration. Convert your custom UI configuration to a JSON string based on the configuration template, and pass it in through this parameter. For more information, see IDV UI style customization (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/idv-kyc-custom-skin?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i60)
parameters.help_zh: 自定义UI配置。根据配置模板，将您自定义的UI配置转换为JSON字符串后，通过该接口传入实现。更多信息，请参见IDV UI样式自定义 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/idv-kyc-custom-skin?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i60)
parameters.name: style_config

parameters.help_en: The experience code
parameters.help_zh: 体验码
parameters.name: experience_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to collect a verification video.

N: No (default).

Y: A short video (1 to 2 seconds) of the user's face verification process is collected and returned through the query operation.

Because video files are large, the system discards video files when the network is unstable to prioritize the transmission of images required for verification
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要存证视频。

N：不需要（默认）。

Y：认证过程中会同时采集用户的刷脸过程视频（1~2s视频文件），并通过查询接口返回。

因为视频文件较大，当网络不稳定时系统会丢弃视频文件，优先保障认证必要图片传输
parameters.name: doc_video

parameters.help_en:
The type of liveness detection to perform.

LIVENESS (default): Blink-based liveness detection.

PHOTINUS_LIVENESS: Dual detection combining blink-based liveness detection and flash-based liveness detection.


For supported SDK versions, see SDK release notes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/sdk-publishing-record?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i99).
Flash-based dual liveness detection is not supported on PCs
parameters.help_zh:
要进行活体检测的类型：

LIVENESS（默认）：眨眼动作活体检测。

PHOTINUS_LIVENESS：眨眼动作活体+炫彩活体双重检测。


支持集成的SDK版本，请参见SDK发布记录 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ekyc/latest/sdk-publishing-record?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.i99)。
PC端不支持炫彩活体双重检测
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en:
The custom OCR quality detection threshold mode. Valid values:
0: Standard mode.
1: Strict mode.
2: Loose mode.
3 (default): Quality detection disabled
parameters.help_zh:
自定义OCR质量检测阈值模式：
0：标准模式
1：严格模式
2：宽松模式
3（默认）：关闭质量检测
parameters.name: id_threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the album upload entry during the document OCR recognition step. Valid values:

1: Display. This is the default value.

0: Do not display
parameters.help_zh:
证件OCR识别环节，是否展示相册上传入口：

1：展示（默认）

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow a degraded processing method when compatibility issues occur during mobile H5 authentication
parameters.help_zh:
当移动端H5方式认证出现兼容性问题时，是否允许展示降级的处理方式。

url（默认）：支持降级。页面展示认证URL，用户可复制URL打开或者切换浏览器继续认证。

keep：不支持降级。直接返回错误原因，并结束认证流程。



PC端不支持此开关。
若业务应用场景为App内嵌网页完成认证，建议此参数设置为keep，不允许降级URL

parameters.help_en:
<warning>This feature is not supported by the Web SDK. To use this feature, use the App SDK.</warning>

Y: Enabled. This is the default value.
N: Not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
<warning>该功能Web SDK暂不支持，如需使用请参考App SDK接入。</warning>

是否开启人脸严格质量检测：
Y：开启（默认）
N：不开启

parameters.help_en: The custom configuration for whether to collect additional pages

parameters.help_zh: 验证的类型
parameters.name: verify_model

parameters.help_en: The face libraries to compare against
parameters.help_zh: 需要比对的人脸库
parameters.name: face_group_codes

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded portrait photo
parameters.help_zh: 人像照片Base64编码
parameters.name: target_face_picture

parameters.help_en: The URL of the portrait image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 人像图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: target_face_picture_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic registration
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动注册
parameters.name: auto_registration

parameters.help_en: The face registration library
parameters.help_zh: 注册人脸库
parameters.name: face_register_group_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to save the face picture
parameters.help_zh: 是否保存人脸图片

parameters.help_en: The face verification threshold
parameters.help_zh: 人脸验证阈值
parameters.name: face_verify_threshold

parameters.help_en: The number of duplicate faces to return

parameters.name: return_faces

parameters.help_en: The Indonesian phone number. The format must be verified (starting with +62, followed by 9 to 11 digits). This field takes effect only when Authorize is set to T
parameters.help_zh:
传入印度尼西亚电话号码，需校验格式（以+62开头，后接9-11位数字），此字段仅在Authorize=T时生效。

parameters.help_en: The execution order of liveness detection actions in TemplateConfig
parameters.help_zh:
TemplateConfig活体检测动作执行顺序。
当 Model 为 TEMPLATE 时，需传入此参数。

Seq：按TemplateConfig配置的顺序从左至右执行。
Ran ：随机乱序执行，选择此项时，TemplateConfig必须配置多于1个动作
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom action pool configuration for liveness detection.
This parameter is required when Model is set to TEMPLATE.
Configuration rule: Separate multiple action codes with commas. Best practice: Include at least one frontal face action (such as blink), and use no more than 3 actions in total.
Action code table:

Blink: 01
Open Mouth: 02
Shake Head Left: 03
Shake Head Right: 04
Move Farther: 05
Move Closer: 06
Photinus: 07
parameters.help_zh:
活体检测自定义动作池配置。
当 Model 为 TEMPLATE 时，需传入此参数。
配置规则：多个动作代码使用英文逗号分隔。最佳实践：建议包含至少一个正脸动作（如眨眼），且总数不超过 3 个。
动作代码表：

眨眼（Blink）：01
张嘴（Open Mouth）：02
左摇头（Shake Head Left）：03
右摇头（Shake Head Right）：04
拉远摄像头（Move Farther）：05
拉近摄像头（Move Closer）：06
炫彩检测（Photinus）：07
parameters.name: template_config

parameters.help_en: The number of actions to randomly select from TemplateConfig
parameters.help_zh:
从TemplateConfig中随机抽取的动作数量。
仅当 TemplateType 为 Ran 时生效。

-校验规则：
数值必须大于1。数值小于等于 TemplateConfig 中配置的动作总数。若不传，默认等于 TemplateConfig 中的动作总数
parameters.name: template_ran_count

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to additionally return OCR recognition results in standardized format fields:
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要额外返回OCR识别标准化格式字段：

0：否 (默认)

1：是
parameters.name: ocr_value_standard

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable face attribute check
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启人脸特征检查
parameters.name: face_attribute_check

parameters.help_en: The automatic document classification configuration
parameters.help_zh: 自动卡证分类配置
parameters.name: auto_doc_page_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to overwrite the existing face with the current face when MerchantUserId already exists during automatic registration. Y: overwrite. N: do not overwrite and return a message indicating that the UserId already exists
parameters.help_zh: 自动入库时若 MerchantUserId 已存在，是否使用本次人脸覆盖原有人脸。Y：覆盖；N：不覆盖并返回 UserId 已存在
parameters.name: update_face_if_user_exists

Protocol.description_zh:
认证标准加密协议。

H5网页接入，选择iframe内嵌集成时依赖该字段
